request.query: negation invariance of sum absolute values of integer multivariate polynomial coefficients

items.name: IsAbsoluteValue.abv_neg
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing S] [inst_1 : PartialOrder S] [IsOrderedRing S] [NoZeroDivisors S]
  [inst_4 : Ring R] (abv : R → S) [IsAbsoluteValue abv] (a : R), abv (-a) = abv a

items.name: tsum_comp_neg
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace α] {β : Type u_4} [inst_2 : InvolutiveNeg β]
  (f : β → α), ∑' (d : β), f (-d) = ∑' (d : β), f d

items.name: Polynomial.smeval_neg
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : Ring R] {S : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup S] [inst_2 : Pow S ℕ] [inst_3 : Module R S]
  (p : Polynomial R) (x : S), (-p).smeval x = -p.smeval x

items.name: Polynomial.roots_neg
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R), (-p).roots = p.roots

items.name: Polynomial.toFinsupp_neg
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (a : Polynomial R), (-a).toFinsupp = -a.toFinsupp

items.name: MonomialOrder.degree_neg
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {m : MonomialOrder σ} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  m.degree (-f) = m.degree f
